title: Arrest Processing
summary: From the street to the charging decision under Criminal Justice Reform.

steps.text: Search incident to arrest; secure property and evidence
Confirm identity and check for warrants and restraining orders
Note injuries and request medical attention if needed
Miranda before any custodial questioning; record as required
Fingerprints and photographs for indictable offenses (Live Scan)
Collect DNA where the law requires it for the arrest charge
Allow a phone call per agency policy
Decide complaint-summons or complaint-warrant under the AG directive and county guidelines
Get prosecutor approval where your county requires it
Write a specific affidavit of probable cause
Warrant: submit to a judge; the PSA is generated for the release decision
Summons: serve the defendant and release with the court date
Victim notification and rights information where required
Property and evidence logged and secured
Reports completed and BWC footage tagged

note: Follow your department's policy and current AG directives. Not yet verified against official sources.
